key_insight: RLAnything jointly forges environment, policy, and reward models in a closed-loop optimization, amplifying learning signals and improving RL performance for LLMs and agentic systems.
problem_solved: Overcomes limitations of static RL pipelines—sparse/noisy rewards and decoupled env/policy/reward components—by creating a dynamic system that produces stronger, consistent learning signals.
method: Integrate environment, policy, and reward into a closed-loop training pipeline so each component continuously adapts to the others.
Train the policy with combined step-wise and outcome feedback while jointly optimizing the reward model using consistency feedback from policy behavior.
Provide theoretical justification and empirical evaluation showing amplified learning signals and improved robustness across LLM/agent scenarios.
impact: Makes RL training for LLMs and agentic applications more efficient and robust by reducing reliance on hand-crafted rewards and enabling adaptive, self-improving systems.

paper_title: RLAnything: Forge Environment, Policy, and Reward Model in Completely Dynamic RL System
paper_authors: Yinjie Wang, Tianbao Xie, Ke Shen, Mengdi Wang, Ling Yang
